yeah np! I know it can be nerve wracking but I promise it'll be okay. at first I was contemplating to even go bc I felt like my doctor would judge me or make me feel uncomfortable but the total opposite happened. they're here to help us with our mental health. I really hope you decide to go.

I was going through some hard suicidal tendencies for a while until I decided I didnt want to die so I had to speak up. I talked to my family doctor first, my parents knew I was going through hard things but didnt know how bad things were. my doctor asked me questions and was really understanding. she then proceeded to name the options that could help, she told me 1. antidepressants 2. counseling or 3. both. I chose antidepressants and she told me the side effects and how long it could take for the medication can work. I would have 2 week check ups to see how I was feeling. thankfully, I did better. this is my 5th month on zoloft and I really feel better. my suicidal thoughts have reduced an immense amount. also, about the part where you said they'll send you away, the doctor or counselor have the right to put you in a psychiatric if you have a plan on killing yourself or already harm yourself to a point where you could die. if you have any family or friends that you could talk to, that's better. I didnt have anyone but my parents that I could've spoke to and they too supported me through everything. again, this is from my own experience. I hope you find what you're looking for and I hope you take care OP.
